name: Dina R. Khismatulina
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
about: Dina R. Khismatulina is an attorney who represents clients in the Atlanta, Georgia area. Dina Khismatulina is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2020 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Dina Khismatulina chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. She attended Emory University School of Law and graduated in 2014. Dina Khismatulina passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1999.
She represents clients with Family Law issues in Georgia. She also represents clients with International issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Dina Khismatulina has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
